ammonia.reason: Early surface deamination by Geotrichum/Penicillium yields low NH3 at 4-6 weeks.

animal_barnyard.reason: Minimal Tyr/Trp degradation to p-cresol/indole in pasteurized short-aged rind.

bitter.reason: Limited accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from short rennet proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: Grey Penicillium nalgiovense/Geotrichum makes little 2-heptanone/2-nonanone vs P. roqueforti.

browning.reason: High moisture and low free amino acids/reducing sugars limit Maillard browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis converts citrate to diacetyl/acetoin in young curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis in 5-week cow curd yields low butanoic/hexanoic acids.

creaminess.reason: Surface proteolysis and lipolysis soften paste under rind to creamy while core stays firm.

crumbliness.reason: Uncooked pressed rennet curd with open structure fractures rather than slicing smooth.

firmness.reason: Pressed ~39% moisture pH 5.2 calcium-retaining curd gives medium-firm body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in young rind.

fruity.reason: Brief aging limits esterase formation of ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine branched C6-C10 acids like 4-ethyloctanoic acid.

malty_nutty.reason: Short proteolysis gives minimal leucine Strecker 3-methylbutanal; no cooked-curd pyrazines.

melt.reason: pH 5.2 intact casein network with ~30% fat flows moderately without pasta-filata structure.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Surface Geotrichum/Penicillium lipoxygenase makes 1-octen-3-ol/3-octanone; nettle wrap adds earthy note.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat in intact protein matrix releases little free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking process; no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Mesophilic starter lactic plus trace acetic acid retained at pH ~5.2 gives lactic tang.

stretch.reason: No hot-water kneading; calcium-linked casein does not align into fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No curd cooking and low methionine catabolism; minimal H2S/methanethiol.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and mild acidity perceived as lactic sweetness.

umami.reason: Modest rennet plus starter proteolysis releases some glutamate by 5 weeks.
